spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/event-gated-adaptive-horizon && LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 python -u dreamer.py --configs defaults dmc_proprio --task dmc_cheetah_run --steps 210000 --seed 0 --device cuda:0 --compile False --gate_enabled True --gate_fixed_dt 2 --gate_subsample_max_dt 2 --imag_horizon 8 --wide_critic True --logdir logdir/exp_037_wide_critic_cheetah"

experiment_data.hypothesis: Wide single critic on Cheetah: if capacity=recovery generalizes from Walker (exp_033, NVE 4.75→self-repair, eval 408) to Cheetah (high CIVO, baseline NVE ~70.64), then Recovery mechanism works across CIVO severity levels. Combined with exp_034 (dual-critic Cheetah, NVE 1.75, eval 97.5), establishes that both Prevention and Recovery are environment-dependent.
